name: a-path-before-a-word-names-the-verb
expect: "`/ne` is a path, a value: a part is read by `get`, `get /ne | \"\"`, and a verb is called by its name alone, `ne \"\"`"

name: call-stray-comma
expect: "modifiers are separated by spaces, not by commas: `f a b`"

name: a-word-after-a-literal-step
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "1 2"
  :marker "  ^"
  :message "steps are joined by `|`: write `a | b`"
  :location ::span[2 1 3 3 1 4]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: a-modifier-against-the-one-before
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "add (1)(2)"
  :marker "       ^~~"
  :message "words are set off by whitespace; only the first modifier of a command may touch its name, `f(a) (b)`"
  :location ::span[7 1 8 10 1 11]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: a-call-by-habit-inside-a-literal
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "[mul(2) add(1)]"
  :marker "    ^~~        "
  :message "the words of a literal are set off by whitespace: `[1 2]`"
  :location ::span[4 1 5 7 1 8]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: a-question-mark-after-a-path-leads-to-query
expect: ["a part that may be missing is read by `query`, which answers null where it misses: write `query /age`" "a part that may be missing is read by `query`, which answers null where it misses: write `query /a/b`"]

name: a-comma-in-the-parentheses-of-a-quote-names-the-command-form
expect: "modifiers are separated by spaces, not by commas: `f a b`"

name: a-path-before-a-word-names-the-read-of-the-part
expect: "`/tags` is a path, a value: a part is read by `get`, `get /tags | count`, and a verb is called by its name alone, `tags count`"
